title: Adaptive scales and a principal-type solution estimate

completed_component_scope: The transverse symbol can be small, have one sign, or factor through a simple zero. One phase-space scale detects these alternatives and lets their different estimates be summed with uniform constants. We construct that scale, prove the factorization with all derivative bounds, and obtain the full small-time solution estimate. reviewed_arguments: The full adaptive trichotomy and global 16T estimate are proved with a real imaginary symbol, complex lower-order symbol, continuous transverse derivatives, no time derivative, all coefficient bounds and exact smallness quantifiers.
